in_marathi.name: Jatinder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jatinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jatinder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Jat' meaning sun and 'Indra' meaning king or god of rain. Thus, Jatinder can be interpreted as the 'Sun God King' or 'King of the Sun'.

in_bengali.name: Jatinder
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jatinder একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jatinder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Jat' meaning sun and 'Indra' meaning king or god of rain. Thus, Jatinder can be interpreted as the 'Sun God King' or 'King of the Sun'.
